text:
Lina Gomez: kicking off staged canary for v3.5.0 now -> sa-east 6%, eu-north 5%. Change window 22:30-01:30 UTC. Stop/go? watching: 401 auth rate, 99p latency, pod RSS. deploy tag r-20260322-35
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Initiated rollout r-20260322-35 -> v3.5.0 segments: sa-east(6%), eu-north(5%). Fallback snapshot v3.4.7 created. Autoscaler: enabled.
Ben Turner: seeing auth failures in sa-east: 401s jumped from 0.6% -> 3.9% in 90s, user-facing failures mostly POST /chat. No 5xx.
SRE Lead: pause criteria: pause if 5xx >0.5% OR auth failures >2% sustained for 3m. Pausing automatic ramps until we triage.
Lina Gomez: @Deploy Bot pin fallback v3.4.7 and pause scheduled bumps.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: fallback v3.4.7 pinned for r-20260322-35. Automatic ramps paused. Notifying oncall.
Avi Shah: quick repro attempt, got this locally:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-16k","input":"hi"}'
# returns 401 with body: {"error":"invalid key: missing scope"}
```
Ben Turner: looks like auth middleware bumped required scope check recently in auth-lib v2.0.5. Some tokens from legacy clients lack new scope.
Product PM: tagging support and docs to notify affected clients; want to avoid broad rollback if we can quick-fix.
Lina Gomez: decision: hold for up to 25m. If auth failures don't drop under 2% after targeted hotfix, rollback to v3.4.7. SRE: roll back immediately on any 5xx surge >0.75%.
Avi Shah: pushing targeted patch to relax scope check fallback logic while we notify clients. Building hotfix v3.5.1-relax-scope.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Hotfix build v3.5.1-relax-scope created and queued for canary replace. CI: running.
Ben Turner: meanwhile i've disabled the stricter policy in the edge-auth rule for sa-east as a temporary mitigation.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: CI green. Replacing canary with v3.5.1-relax-scope now.
Avi Shah: replacement done. Re-running canary smoke. 401 rate dropped to 0.8% in 2m, median latency unchanged.
SRE Lead: monitoring: no 5xx, auth <1% sustained 4m. Heap/RSS stable.
Product PM: sending note to support + small status blurb to customers explaining token scope change and mitigation.
Lina Gomez: OK to proceed with rollforward plan: after 10m stable bump sa-east -> 25%, eu-north -> 20% after 20m. Documenting stop/go here as record.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Scheduled bump to sa-east 25% in 10m for r-20260322-35 unless paused. Notifying stakeholders.
Ben Turner: follow-up: we'll schedule a migration doc for legacy tokens and add a telemetry tag to track affected clients.
Lina Gomez: thanks all. Keep this thread as the official stop/go. Ping me if anything changes and we'll hit rollback. :white_check_mark:
